lines.speaker: AVA
lines.text: Thanks for calling the office — this is AVA. How can I help you today?

lines.speaker: CALLER
lines.text: I've had a toothache since Saturday and it's getting worse.

lines.speaker: AVA
lines.text: Ouch — three days is long enough. On a one-to-ten, where's the pain right now?

lines.speaker: CALLER
lines.text: Like a seven. Does the exam include—

lines.speaker: AVA
lines.text: I was just getting there — new-patient exam with X-rays is ninety-five, everything included.

lines.speaker: CALLER
lines.text: Okay. How soon can I come in?

lines.speaker: AVA
lines.text: Tomorrow at eleven-forty. The doctor holds morning slots for pain cases exactly like this.

lines.speaker: AVA
lines.text: Eleven-forty tomorrow — you're booked. Your confirmation text is on its way.

lines.speaker: AVA
lines.text: Cold compress tonight, Jess — you're in good hands tomorrow.
